figures.caption: Weighted regressions of calibrated e₁, e₂ against the corresponding PSF model ellipticity at each galaxy, without an object-wise leakage correction. Eight equal-count resolution bins each have eight equal-count SNR bins. Hatching marks |α| < 2σ; σ is the weighted least-squares fit uncertainty.
figures.alt: Weighted regressions of calibrated e₁, e₂ against the corresponding PSF model ellipticity at each galaxy, without an object-wise leakage correction. Eight equal-count resolution bins each have eight equal-count SNR bins. Hatching marks |α| < 2σ; σ is the weighted least-squares fit uncertainty.

figures.caption: Linear fits to weighted means of calibrated ellipticity in 20 fixed bins of each standardised property. Error bars and significances use inverse-variance fits to binned means with independent-galaxy shape-noise errors; they omit spatially correlated noise, notably for RA and Dec. Galaxy size is √T and the size ratio is T/T_PSF; only objects inside the fixed property ranges are used.
figures.alt: Linear fits to weighted means of calibrated ellipticity in 20 fixed bins of each standardised property. Error bars and significances use inverse-variance fits to binned means with independent-galaxy shape-noise errors; they omit spatially correlated noise, notably for RA and Dec. Galaxy size is √T and the size ratio is T/T_PSF; only objects inside the fixed property ranges are used.

figures.caption: Scale-dependent leakage α(θ) = τ₀/ρ₀ for all galaxies and in galaxy-magnitude tertiles (calibrated e₁, e₂ rescaled to each bin's shear response plus the global selection response, w_des; jackknife errors). The selection response is larger for the faint bin, so its |α| is likely underestimated by ~10–20%. The paper's DES-Y3 comparison is omitted.
figures.alt: Scale-dependent leakage α(θ) = τ₀/ρ₀ for all galaxies and in galaxy-magnitude tertiles (calibrated e₁, e₂ rescaled to each bin's shear response plus the global selection response, w_des; jackknife errors). The selection response is larger for the faint bin, so its |α| is likely underestimated by ~10–20%. The paper's DES-Y3 comparison is omitted.
